_meta.note: Apple does NOT publish a numeric spacing or radius scale. The hit target and continuous-corner facts are from the HIG; the spacing grid and radii are common community conventions, tagged as such. Prefer system spacing (SwiftUI default padding, Layout Margins) over magic numbers.
_meta.verify_against: HIG > Foundations > Layout; HIG > Accessibility (control sizes)

hit_target.note: min_pt / shape = the DEFAULT (recommended) control size on iOS / iPadOS, kept under this name for compatibility; Apple's hard minimum there is 28x28. Other platforms differ: see per_platform. Never go below the minimum.

spacing_between_controls.note: About 12pt of padding around controls with a bezel; about 24pt around the visible edges of controls without one.

hit_target.source: HIG > Accessibility > Mobility (control size table), checked 2026-10-17

layout_margin_pt.note: Use system Layout Margins / safe area insets rather than hardcoding where possible.

floating_inset.note: Apple publishes no numeric inset for floating glass panels / controls above a tab bar. Use a spacing-scale step (16-24pt) from the screen edge and clear the tab bar via safe-area insets, not a magic number.

radii.curvature: Apple uses CONTINUOUS corners (squircle), not circular. In SwiftUI use RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:, style: .continuous).
radii.concentricity: Nested rounded shapes should be concentric: outer_radius = inner_radius + padding, so corners stay parallel.

common_control_pt.note: Confirm against the live component; many system controls use capsule or system-managed radii.
